value.title: Company history and network counter
value.findings: Header reports more than 1760 stores. Use 1760 as a conservative scenario anchor, not an exact census. The separate company page retains older >1600 prose.
value.limitations: No count of rotisserie-capable stores, daily throughput, or package consumption.
value.geographical_relevance: Romania

value.title: Rotisserie equipment capacities
value.findings: TDR5 capacity 15 basket or 20 meatfork birds based on 1.2 kg; TDR7/8 28 or 40. Supports one 20-bird batch as central daily whole-bird scenario.
value.limitations: Equipment capacity is not sales; no evidence Profi uses these ovens. Raw versus cooked weight is not transferable without yield.
value.geographical_relevance: International technical/commercial analogue; transfer limited to stated scope

value.title: Whole rotisserie chicken
